title_zh: 巩俐：华语影坛最具影响力的女演员
title_en: Famous Chinese People (18/20): Gong Li, the Most Influential Actress in Chinese Cinema
note_en: 等 (děng) after a list means "and others" and signals that the list isn't complete: 出演了《大红灯笼高高挂》等很多经典影片 "starred in Raise the Red Lantern and many other classic films." Unlike English "etc.," 等 often comes before a summary noun phrase (等很多经典影片), and it can even follow a single item, as here, to imply there were more.
